school_assignment_source: Institutional Licenciaturas catalog image supplied by project owner on 2026-09-13.
notes: Only non-student catalog sheets were extracted from dev/prod.
No historical student-level rows from Asesorías, Calificaciones, or Diagnóstico are stored in this catalog layer.
Multiple course codes may share the same course name, and a small number of codes have multiple catalog names; conflicts are preserved rather than silently collapsed.
